args.goal: Prepare the existing catalogue offer for the first real eligible inbound case using the documented administrative CAD collection route. Start with the committed catalogue qualified-inquiry handoff, item-4-release-binding.json, completed text-only fulfillment rehearsal, payment-handoff operator instructions and current Interac contract. Reuse and verify an equivalent committed catalogue-specific order handoff if present. Otherwise compare the verified live terms with the administrative prerequisites and use one fictional eligible inquiry to exercise the handoff as an offline decision table. Include a diagnostic-only case and a case that asks to commission work. If the live offer and documented terms permit escalation, produce a copy-ready bilingual operator packet with exact scope, exclusions, acceptance checks, AI disclosure and evidence required at each step. If accepted terms or authorization are missing, produce a copy-ready nonbinding clarification and state exactly what must be evidenced before an operator can create or accept a paid order. Treat any public price hypothesis as a hypothesis. Do not create an order, send a message externally, disclose payment instructions, access private correspondence, create accounts, spend or deploy. Save and read the actual check and usable handoff under products/services/catalogue-inbound-cad/. Complete under a valid lease with a lesson. Keep eligibility, fulfillment, acceptance, received deposit and Treasury posting distinct. The item 4 operator decision and any checkout platform activation are separate.
